# AGC oracle record: the GL cube frame on PS5 firmware 12.40

What a real console did with one exact command stream, kept so that Orbistoun can check its
own RDNA2 path against it. Everything below was measured on the target part, not a stand-in,
and is `runtime` evidence in the vocabulary of orbistoun's `docs/PROVENANCE.md`: learned from
something executing on hardware, reproducible with the console and the build named here.

## Key

| | |
|---|---|
| target | PlayStation 5, retail unit, firmware 12.40, the GPU as the firmware exposes it (RDNA2 generation; `gfx1030`-class encodings assemble and run) |
| date | 2026-09-14 |
| program | `oops-apps/src/gl-cube` (title `GLCB00001`) over `oops-sdk` `src/gl`, built with `make title` in the app directory through the `oops-builder` WSL distribution: `clang -std=c11 -target x86_64-unknown-freebsd -ffreestanding -fno-builtin -nostdlib -fPIC -fno-stack-protector -fvisibility=hidden -DOOPS_TARGET=3 -fuse-ld=lld -shared -Wl,-Bsymbolic -Wl,-e,gl_cube_start ... -T selfish/link/native_eboot.ld`, wrapped by `selfish --format title` |
| console state | jailbroken retail console with the OOPS shell server and loader payloads resident (the process list shows `elfldr.elf`, `pldmgr.elf`); the title launched by `pros launch GLCB00001` and driven by control files pushed to its directory (`pause`: no animation; `dump`: frame 30 logs this record; `tex`: texture on) |
| frame | frame 30 of a paused run: rotation x 25, y 35, z 10 degrees, camera at -4.5, perspective 45 degrees, depth test on (LESS), back-face culling on (CCW front), lighting on |
| how it was captured | `glRequestHardwareDump()` before the frame; `gl_hw_flush()` logs the stream and the shader words as they sit in memory just before `sceAgcDriverSubmitCommandBuffer`, then the fence and GPU clock after the wait; the application logs the pixel hash it computes from the CP's readback copy of the target |
| pixel hash | FNV-1a 32-bit over all 1920 x 1080 words of the colour target, read from the CP's copy (`DMA_DATA` of the target into CPU-cached memory after the end-of-pipe cache flush), before the HUD or the flip touch anything |

## What the two records say

| record | texture | pixel hash | pixels outside the clear colour | centre pixel (0xAARRGGBB) | GPU clock at end of pipe |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | off (Gouraud pixel shader at payload + 0x300) | `0x9dbfe189` | 580402 | `0xff49bada` | `0x49d0fe7836c` |
| B | on (sampling pixel shader at payload + 0x200) | `0xc51cec32` | 580402 | `0xff44afda` | `0x49f1e432f1d` |

Both hashes are stable frame to frame while paused (record A: 116 consecutive frames; record B:
60) and identical across separate launches of the title on the same day. Both streams are 1052
dwords: the frame's register state, the CP DMA fills that clear colour and depth, twelve draws of
one triangle each, the end-of-pipe fence, the CP's wait on it, the readback copy, and the GPU clock.

Facts these records pin, each measured on this console (details in worklogs 535 and 539 of
orbistoun's `docs/worklog/`).

**Each of these is asserted against the stream `oops-gl` emits today**, by
`test_pm4_gl_honours_the_gl_cube_oracle_record` in `tests/unit/test_pm4.c`. They were prose
here and checked nowhere until 2026-09-16, which meant a register could be edited and this
document would go on describing a frame the code no longer produces. If you change one of
these values, that test is what will tell you, and its display is deliberately 640 x 480 so
the extent fields cannot be transposed without it failing - the transposition the first entry
below records having already been measured once.

- `CB_COLOR0_ATTRIB2`: width - 1 in bits 27:14, height - 1 in bits 13:0; the colour block takes the row pitch from bits 27:14.
- `CB_COLOR0_INFO` `COMP_SWAP=ALT` stores bytes B, G, R, A.
- `PA_CL_VPORT_YSCALE` negative for GL's upward NDC y; culling follows screen-space winding.
- The pixel shader must copy the SGPR after its user data into m0 before `v_interp`: s0 with no user data, s2 with two. `SPI_SHADER_PGM_RSRC2_PS` `USER_SGPR` sits in bits 5:1 (the value 2 loads one SGPR, 4 loads two).
- The NGG stage's user data 0 arrives in s8. `VGT_GS_OUT_PRIM_TYPE` must be TRISTRIP (2) for triangles; POINTLIST turns each triangle into a point and starves the compositor.
- `DB_Z_INFO` with `SW_MODE` 64KB_Z_X and no HTILE (`TILE_SURFACE_ENABLE` 0, `DB_HTILE_DATA_BASE` 0) gives a working depth test; the surface needs the 128 x 128 block extent.
- A 2D image descriptor: base address in 256-byte units (word 0 bits 31:0 = address bits 39:8, word 1 bits 7:0 = bits 47:40); `DST_SEL` X, Y, Z, W = 4, 5, 6, 7 reads channels 0..3 of `FMT_8_8_8_8` as R, G, B, A; a linear image's row pitch comes from its width, and the `DEPTH` field does not carry it (rows laid twice as far apart sample identically wrong with DEPTH = pitch - 1 or 0).
- `DMA_DATA` (0xc0055000) with SRC_SEL DATA and DST_SEL TC_L2 fills memory; with both SRC_SEL and DST_SEL at TC_L2 it copies; `WAIT_REG_MEM` (0xc0053c00, function EQUAL, memory space) holds the CP on the fence; `RELEASE_MEM` with DATA_SEL 3 writes a 64-bit GPU clock counter that runs at 100 MHz (99.75 ticks per microsecond of CPU time over 17.9 s, measured).
- GPU reads of `WC_GARLIC` direct memory work (the texture is sampled from it).

## Records

Lines are the klog output, unedited apart from the `[OOPS-GL]` / `[GL-CUBE]` prefixes.
`dcb NNNN:` lines are dwords of the command stream at dword index NNNN (hex), eight per line;
`vs`, `pstex`, `ps` and `desc` lines are the shader payload at `oracle-payload-va` + 0x000,
+ 0x200, + 0x300 and + 0x900 in the same form. `oracle-hash` is the pixel hash of the frame the
stream drew.
